Movement uses every frame and duration; directions, reflection and selection are blocked while animating, while Space still prevents scrolling
Undo during an animation restores both heroes and cancels stale callbacks
Reset, level changes and return to tutorial cancel pending animation callbacks and reset the appropriate counters
8 inspected room(s) display their source attribution and relevant piston/platform help
8 inspected room(s) keep one orange Merchant, one green Thief and two goals; selecting the current hero makes no action or Undo entry
Space, X and the Reflet button perform the same real reflection and preserve every teleport frame

Undo exits final victory and restores progression; Restart returns to the open tutorial with zero completions
Real reachable defeats display all movement/combat frames before the terminal overlay, block further commands, and support mid-animation Undo plus defeat-panel Undo/Reset
